output_list.reason: The numguesses variable is incremented by one in the _addguess() function, and then it is compared to the arraysize. If the numguesses is set to arraysize, it will call the _finish() function, which will then call the findWinner() function. However, due to the comparison (numguesses >= arraysize), it will always execute the _finish() function, regardless of the value of numguesses. This allows an attacker to control the value of numguesses, and cause the contract to always call the _finish() function, regardless of the betting price. This will cause a potential loss of funds for the contract.
